dialogue_quality_notes: Turns are concise and context-appropriate (confirmations, order placement, pickup requests).

Environment updates consistently track recorded/prepared/served state and align with spoken turns.
evaluation.final_reason: Throughout the run all requests were acknowledged and acted on; no participant asserted an incompatible claim or demand that remained unsettled.
position_change_notes: No participant materially changed position; Agent B consistently recorded and prepared the order as confirmed.
Agent A maintained the request and acted to pick up when ready; Agent D placed a separate order and Agent C inquired about timing without pressing for priority.

round_scores.evidence: Agent A asked whether 'dry, no chilli' was recorded; Agent B explicitly confirmed ('Okay, recording: chicken noodles, dry, no chilli') and began preparing the order (environment update). No incompatible claims or demands were made.

Order reached pickup and Agent B served the dry_no_chilli order to Agent A. Agent D placed a separate order ('Chicken noodles, soup, with chilli.') but did not dispute existing actions. No incompatible demands were expressed.

Agent C asked when the next order could start; Agent B recorded a new order (soup_with_chilli) but environment notes B cannot start preparation because an order was just served. This is a scheduling/status note, not an expressed disagreement about incompatible claims.

substantive_insights: Agent B reliably confirmed and executed the specific preparation requested by Agent A, preventing potential mis-order conflict.
Agent D's differing order did not create a conflict because it was a separate request and the server proceeded sequentially.
Agent C's inquiry about timing highlights a potential queue/wait concern, but no incompatible demand or complaint was made.
